superPowers.name: Landslide
superPowers.body: Choose an enemy character of |!size| 4 or less within |!range| 3. Push the chosen character Away |!movement_small|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Beware Falling Debris
superPowers.body: When an enemy character ends an Advance within |!range| 3 of this character, this character may use this superpower. Choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 3 or less within |!range| 2 of the enemy character that was Advanced. Destroy that terrain feature. The enemy character suffers a collision as if the terrain feature had collided with it.
